form.label: ATLAS Matrix
form.description: This dashboard provides an overview of available correlation searches that match MITRE ATLAS techniques. Darker colors indicate higher ratio of enabled rules and you can view the actual numbers when hovering over the cells and click to drilldown further for editing the rules.

input.label: Matrix Display Scope
input.choice: User-Defined and MITRE ATLAS App Rules

table.title: MITRE ATLAS Compliance Lookup Gen Status

search.query: | rest splunk_server=local /services/saved/searches/ | search title="MITRE ATLAS User Rules Compliance Lookup Gen" splunk_server = local | fields title, next_scheduled_time, updated | rename title as "Lookup Generator Name", next_scheduled_time as "Next Scheduled Run", updated as "Last Scheduled Run" | join "Lookup Generator Name" type=left [| rest splunk_server=local /services/data/lookup-table-files | search title = "atlas_all_rule_compliance_lookup.csv" | fields title, updated | rename title as "Lookup Table Name", updated as "Time of Latest Lookup Table Update" | eval "Lookup Generator Name" = "MITRE ATLAS User Rules Compliance Lookup Gen" ] | fillnull value="" | eval Instruction=if('Lookup Table Name'="","Lookup table is empty, CLICK HERE to manually run the report and populate the lookup file.","If you want to REFRESH the below table you need CLICK HERE to manually run the setup and repopulate the lookup file.")

| inputlookup $tok_display_option$ | rename AML.TA0002 as TA0002, AML.TA0003 as TA0003, AML.TA0004 as TA0004, AML.TA0000 as TA0000, AML.TA0005 as TA0005, AML.TA0006 as TA0006, AML.TA0012 as TA0012, AML.TA0007 as TA0007, AML.TA0013 as TA0013, AML.TA0008 as TA0008, AML.TA0015 as TA0015, AML.TA0009 as TA0009, AML.TA0001 as TA0001, AML.TA0014 as TA0014, AML.TA0010 as TA0010, AML.TA0011 as TA0011 | foreach TA00* [| lookup atlas_tt_lookup technique_id as <<FIELD>> OUTPUTNEW technique_name as <<FIELD>>_technique_name | eval <<FIELD>>_technique_name=mvindex(<<FIELD>>_technique_name,0) | lookup atlas_user_rule_compliance_lookup technique_id as <<FIELD>> OUTPUTNEW enabled_percentage as <<FIELD>>_perc, count as <<FIELD>>_count, enabled_count as <<FIELD>>_enabled | fillnull value="NULL" <<FIELD>>,<<FIELD>>_technique_name,<<FIELD>>_perc,<<FIELD>>_count,<<FIELD>>_enabled | eval <<FIELD>>_count=if("all_rules"=="only_enabled_rules", <<FIELD>>_enabled,<<FIELD>>_count), <<FIELD>>_perc=if("all_rules"=="only_enabled_rules" AND <<FIELD>>_perc!="NULL" AND <<FIELD>>_perc!=0,100, <<FIELD>>_perc) | eval <<FIELD>>_perc=if("all_rules"=="only_enabled_rules" AND <<FIELD>>_perc="0" ,"NULL", <<FIELD>>_perc) | eval <<FIELD>>=<<FIELD>>."|".<<FIELD>>_technique_name."|".<<FIELD>>_perc."|".<<FIELD>>_enabled."|".<<FIELD>>_count]
| fields TA0002, TA0003,TA0004, TA0000, TA0005, TA0006, TA0012, TA0007, TA0013, TA0008, TA0015, TA0009, TA0001, TA0014, TA0010, TA0011 | rename TA0002 as "Reconnaissance", TA0003 as "Resource Development",TA0004 as "Initial Access", TA0000 as "AI Model Access", TA0005 as "Execution", TA0006 as "Persistence", TA0012 as "Privilege Escalation", TA0007 as "Defense Evasion", TA0013 as "Credential Access", TA0008 as "Discovery", TA0015 as "Lateral Movement", TA0009 as "Collection", TA0001 as "AI Attack Staging", TA0014 as "Command and Control", TA0010 as "Exfiltration", TA0011 as "Impact"
